text_markup: Some abilities reference cards by a lack of subtype, such as "non-{subtype:virus}". These abilities can only affect cards that do not have the specified subtype, regardless of any other subtypes the cards do have.
text_plain: Some abilities reference cards by a lack of subtype, such as "non-virus". These abilities can only affect cards that do not have the specified subtype, regardless of any other subtypes the cards do have.
